[SWS_CM_10454] Event message segmentation
Upstream requirements:
RS_SOMEIP_00051
⌈
If the attribute
SomeipEventDeployment
.
maximumSegmentLength
is set to a
value, and the data length is larger than
maximumSegmentLength
,
the SOME/IP
event message
shall be transmitted/received using segmentation as described in
[PRS_SOMEIP_00720] and following.
